scope: 20 synthetic development cases, refined during this session; not held-out or human gold

remaining_fidelity_issues.anger: Adds disappointment with results beyond the supplied anger about performance.
remaining_fidelity_issues.forecast: Adds that the announcement will be made soon; the source supplies no announcement time.
remaining_fidelity_issues.other: Narrows delight with the other team to delight with its performance; the source does not specify why.

improved: No invented crowds, direct-speech quotations or gender in the final replay. Historical reporting stays attributed to its earlier source.
